purpose: Independent human lock/reject/repair review of one exact T079 diversity packet. Benchmark truth fields remain human judgments and are required only when disposition=lock for a locked candidate.
rules: The construction stress category is an intent, not the expected human outcome.
Only observed or externally_verified metadata may count as known coverage.
Provider multiplicity, mirrors and duplicate editions must not manufacture canonical-family diversity.
The reviewer may reject or require repair instead of locking a packet.

For disposition=lock on a locked_candidate packet, benchmark_truth.material_gap, adequate, justified_narrow and seeded_fake_or_missing_strata must each be explicit booleans supplied by the human reviewer; automation must not derive them from the stress-category name or machine_result.
A completed review must set release_evidence=false and decision_origin=human; these fields are provenance controls, not automated judgments.
benchmark_truth.material_gap=true is incompatible with adequate=true or justified_narrow=true.
Any mutation after lock requires a new packet digest/version and a new review.
Automation must leave all reviewer judgment and identity fields blank.
